description: Use this when someone asks how much gravel, crushed stone, sand, topsoil or mulch they need, in cubic yards, tons or bags. Calculates the gravel, crushed stone, chippings, sand, topsoil or mulch that covers an area (a rectangle, a circle or a given area) to a depth: the area in square meters, the loose volume to order in liters, cubic feet and cubic yards (1 cu yd = 764.555 l), which is area × depth × (1 + compaction ÷ 100), the weight in kilograms and US short tons (907.18474 kg) from the loose density, and the bags of each given size that hold it, rounded up. Densities when not given, in kg per m³: gravel 1690, crushedStone 1600, sand 1690 (damp; dry loose sand is 1420) and topsoil 1250 (loam) from Caterpillar's table of loose material weights, chippings 1450 (Splitt, deutschland-rechner.de), mulch 281 (green wood chips, 473 lb per cu yd, EPA). Compaction: toom adds about 10 % for a crushed stone base, deutschland-rechner.de 6 % for base courses. byWeight tells whether merchants sell the material by weight: gravel, crushed stone, chippings and sand. bags holds the bag counts in the order of bagKilograms and then bagLiters. Common bags: 50 lb (0.5 cu ft) of gravel or sand in the US; 20 kg and 850 kg bulk bags in the UK; bulk bags of 500 and 1000 kg in Germany; mulch in 1.5 and 2 cu ft, or 50, 60 and 100 l.

area.description: Area to cover in square meters, used instead of the sizes.

bagKilograms.description: Sizes of bags sold by weight, in kilograms, such as 20, 25, 500 or 1000 (a 50 lb bag is 22.68).

bagLiters.description: Sizes of bags sold by volume, in liters, such as 40, 60 or 1000 (0.5 cu ft is 14.16, 2 cu ft 56.63).

compaction.description: Percent of loose material added for the layer to settle or be compacted to its depth, such as 10 for a compacted crushed stone base; none when left out.

density.description: Loose density in kilograms per cubic meter (1 US short ton per cubic yard = 1186.55); when left out gravel 1690, crushedStone 1600, chippings 1450, sand 1690, topsoil 1250, mulch 281.

depth.description: Depth of the finished layer, in millimeters.

diameter.description: Diameter of a round area, used instead of length and width, in millimeters.

length.description: Length of a rectangular area, in millimeters.

width.description: Width of a rectangular area, in millimeters.
